title: RLHF taught models manners from ranked preferences
body: InstructGPT showed that fine-tuning on human demonstrations, then optimising against a reward model trained on human rankings of outputs, made a 1.3-billion-parameter model preferred over the raw 175-billion GPT-3. Alignment turned out to be teachable signal, not only scale. Modern assistants are that recipe, industrialised with more data and debate.
